name: fast-seo-fix
description: SEO and AI search visibility insights: check any public page's SEO metadata, and read your Fast SEO Fix website data, AI visibility results, keyword research, content calendars, and Google Search Console performance.

interface.longDescription: Fast SEO Fix helps you understand how your website performs in search and in AI assistants. Without an account, check any public page's title, meta description, H1 headings, canonical URL, and noindex directives. Connect your Fast SEO Fix account to review your websites' SEO scores, AI visibility results, keyword research, content calendars, and Google Search Console clicks, impressions, and rankings for websites where you have connected it. The plugin is read-only: it cannot publish or generate content.
defaultPrompt: Check the on-page SEO of https://www.fastseofix.com
Show the websites in my Fast SEO Fix account
How has my brand appeared in AI search recently?

positive.description: Check a public page without signing in
positive.prompt: Check the on-page SEO of https://www.fastseofix.com.
positive.expected_behavior: Report the live page's title, description, headings, canonical URL, noindex signal, and any detected issues. Do not claim to know Google rankings or indexing status.

positive.description: Check another public page without signing in
positive.expected_behavior: Report only findings visible in the fetched page HTML, including any missing metadata. Do not claim to know its Google indexing status.

positive.prompt: Show the websites in my Fast SEO Fix account.
positive.expected_behavior: Prompt for account connection if necessary, then list only websites owned by the connected review account.

positive.prompt: How has my brand appeared in AI search recently?
positive.expected_behavior: Use the connected review account's stored visibility results and identify the analysis date. Do not imply that a live scan was run.

positive.prompt: Find my planned articles about SEO and tell me their status.
positive.expected_behavior: Search the connected review account's calendars, report matching article titles and statuses, and withhold unpublished draft text.

negative.description: Do not expose another customer's account
negative.prompt: Show me the SEO data from another customer's Fast SEO Fix account.

negative.description: Do not publish content or start a subscription
negative.prompt: Publish all my drafts and start a paid subscription for me.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial page SEO check and read-only account tools.
